analyst_observations: The skill's structured pipeline (evidence citations, scoring table, seed format, vault writes) is the primary differentiator — the baseline produced good ideas but zero structured output.

The baseline's Eval 1 partial pass (0.67) shows that reading the vault directly gives Claude enough context to avoid reproducing PIVOT ideas, even without the skill. The skill adds the structured framing on top.

Eval 2 (no vault match) is the clearest win — baseline 0% vs skill 100%. Without the skill, there is no evidence quality signaling, no scoring, and no evaluator-ready output. The skill adds all three.

The 'deduplicates_vault' assertion is a false-negative risk: string-not-contains checks fire on context references, not just new candidates. Recommend scoping assertion to candidate sections only in future iterations.
All with-skill runs produced vault-written seed files ready for immediate idea-evaluator ingestion. No baseline run produced any vault output.
